title: Reading Between the Lines
text:
A poem can say a great deal with very few words. Poets often choose images, such as the sea or an old house, to suggest feelings without naming them directly. The tone of a poem, whether it is calm, angry or hopeful, shapes how we read each stanza. Careful readers pay attention to these details.

A stanza is a group of lines that forms a unit within a poem. Many poets end a stanza with a surprising line, which encourages the reader to pause and rethink what came before. Students who read poems aloud often notice rhythm and emphasis that they missed when reading silently.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do poets often choose to suggest feelings?
options: Images such as the sea or an old house

questions.text: What does the second paragraph say many poets do at the end of a stanza?
What can be inferred about a poem with a hopeful tone?
options: It probably makes the reader feel optimistic
It is written only for children
It has no effect on the reader
It must be a very short poem

questions.text: Why might a student who reads poems aloud notice things they missed while reading silently?
options: Sound and rhythm become easier to hear
Poems are only meant to be heard
Reading aloud makes the text shorter

vocabulary.definition: a group of lines that forms a unit within a poem
the mood or attitude a text expresses
descriptions that create a picture in the reader's mind

paragraph_translations: Un poema puede decir mucho con muy pocas palabras. Los poetas suelen elegir imágenes, como el mar o una casa antigua, para sugerir sentimientos sin nombrarlos directamente. El tono de un poema, ya sea tranquilo, enojado o esperanzador, condiciona la forma en que leemos cada estrofa. Los lectores atentos prestan atención a estos detalles.

Una estrofa es un grupo de versos que forma una unidad dentro de un poema. Muchos poetas terminan una estrofa con un verso sorprendente, lo que invita al lector a detenerse y reconsiderar lo que vino antes. Los estudiantes que leen poemas en voz alta suelen notar ritmos y énfasis que se les escapan cuando leen en silencio.
